title: EvacuationSite
description: One designated emergency evacuation site (指定緊急避難場所, Basic Act on Disaster Management Art. 49-4): the master record a municipality publishes in its 指定緊急避難場所一覧, designated per hazard

@context.description: JSON-LD context of the entity, optional: a context URL or a list of context URLs

name.description: Name of the site or the building (名称)

nameKana.description: Name in full-width katakana (名称_カナ)

externalSiteId.description: The site's ID in the municipality's 指定緊急避難場所一覧 (自治体標準オープンデータセット; unique within the municipality). Together with localGovernmentCode it identifies the site nationwide. Required unless nationalShelterId is given (GSI's data has no municipal ID)

nationalShelterId.description: The nationwide common shelter/evacuation-site ID (14 characters, the '共通ID' of GSI's designated emergency evacuation site data). Only type code 20 (designated emergency evacuation site) is valid on this model. Leave it out when none is assigned. Its structure and source are described once, in EvacuationShelter's mapping 'nationwide common shelter/evacuation-site ID' (gsi-national-shelter-id). Required when externalSiteId is not given

localGovernmentCode.description: Local government code of the municipality that designates the site and publishes the list (全国地方公共団体コード, 6 digits)

address.description: Address of the site, as a JapaneseAddress value (common subject). Its localGovernmentCode is the code of the municipality the site lies in, which can differ from the publisher's

location.description: Where the site is, as a point

elevation.description: Elevation of the site in metres above mean sea level (標高)

hazardTypes.description: The hazards the site is designated for (災害種別; designation is per hazard): flood (洪水), landslide (崖崩れ、土石流及び地滑り), stormSurge (高潮), earthquake (地震), tsunami (津波), greatFire (大規模な火事), inlandFlood (内水氾濫), eruption (火山現象)

alsoDesignatedShelter.description: true when the site is also a designated shelter (指定避難所との重複)

alsoWelfareShelter.description: true when the site is also a designated welfare shelter (指定福祉避難所との重複)

maxCapacity.description: Number of people the site is planned to hold (想定収容人数)

targetAreas.description: Neighbourhood associations or areas that evacuate to this site (対象となる町会・自治会)
